prompts.enemies: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent sprite atlas for SIGIL BREACH, a 16-bit dark occult first-person shooter. Create a square 1536 x 1536 image containing an EXACT uniform 4 by 4 grid of 16 separate full-body pixel-art sprites. No grid lines, no text, no labels, transparent background with real alpha. Each cell is exactly 384 x 384. Every sprite must be entirely within its own cell with 20px transparent safety margin, aligned feet at cell y=356 and centered at x=192. Crisp deliberately hand-placed pixel clusters, limited 32-color palette per creature, dark contour, sharp highlights, classic 1990s PC shooter sprite craft, menacing grotesque anatomy, never cute, no smooth vector art, no low-poly geometry, no photorealism. Each character is front-facing toward the player, consistent scale and anatomy across its row. ROW 1: tall lean flayed crimson goat demon, long bone horns, molten orange eyes, clawed hands, exposed ribs, cloven hooves. ROW 2: Stolas's owl-headed midnight sorcerer, tattered indigo feather cloak, bone owl mask, luminous icy blue eyes and spell flame, hooked talons. ROW 3: Buer's plague beast, hulking green-black sinewy lion-skull demon with thorn-covered shoulders and toxic green pustules, broad hunched stance, long claws. ROW 4: Margrave of Ash, imposing crowned three-skull infernal knight, blackened brass armor, immense curved horns, red furnace core, ragged crimson tabard. ALL ROWS, COLUMNS 1 THROUGH 4: column 1 advancing left foot; column 2 advancing right foot with corresponding arm swing; column 3 strongly readable attack windup, arms raised and snarling (casters emit a small colored spell at hand); column 4 destroyed, collapsed corpse lying at the bottom of the cell, bones and armor heap, very clearly dead, lower height. No ambient ground shadow outside each silhouette. No sprite overlaps. The atlas is a functional game sheet, not an illustration or contact sheet with margins between cells.
prompts.shotgun: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent first-person weapon animation sheet for a 16-bit occult boomer shooter called SIGIL BREACH. Output landscape 1536 x 1024, EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, six 512x512 frames, no gutters, no text, no labels, no panel outlines. True transparent background. Pixel art with visible crisp chunky pixel clusters, richly shaded steel, battered dark brass, bone inset, tiny glowing orange sigil. A heavy ornate break-action double barrel hunting shotgun, player's leather-gloved hands and forearms at the lower edge. ORIGINAL design, no copied existing game art. Camera is the player's eyes looking along the top of the shotgun toward the enemy, muzzle pointed away into the scene toward the upper center of each cell, NOT a side-view gun pointed left or right, NOT a gun pointed at the viewer. Centered classic FPS composition, stock and hands occupy bottom-center, barrel tapers in perspective up toward center. Every frame entirely inside its own cell with 20px side margin; all fingers coherent. Exactly the same weapon and lighting in every frame. Read in row-major order: 1 READY: steady aim, muzzle around x256 y180, receiver x256 y345, arms at bottom. 2 FIRE: same pose kicked up slightly, bright sharp orange-white muzzle blast at top of both barrels. 3 RECOIL: gun lifted and slightly tilted right, hot smoke, no huge flash. 4 OPEN: gun lowered and tilted slightly left, barrels visibly hinged open, two empty chambers and two spent brass shells ejecting upward. 5 LOAD: exact same broken-open gun, left gloved hand visibly inserting two red shotgun shells into chambers. 6 CLOSE: hands snapping the barrels back up into the receiver, almost aimed again. Readable mechanical animation with significant pose difference in open/load frames. No environmental backdrop, no fake transparency checkerboard.
prompts.lance: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: transparent first-person weapon sprite animation sheet for SIGIL BREACH, 16-bit occult shooter. Output 1536x1024 landscape, EXACT 3 columns and 2 rows, six equal 512x512 cells, no gutters, no text or labels. True alpha background. Rich crisp authentic 1990s pixel-art rendering, visible hand-placed clusters, limited palette, no vector graphics or smooth digital painting. Original eldritch energy weapon: a brutal metal and bone staff-gun, two prongs shaped like an owl's beak framing a bright blue star crystal, silver-blue filigree and worn brass on dark gunmetal. Player sees it in FIRST PERSON, from behind, aiming away from the camera toward upper-center; hands and stock at lower center, muzzle centered x256 near y180, not a side view, not pointing at viewer. Consistent perspective and silhouette across frames, all content inside each cell with 20px margin. Dark leather gloved hands. Six poses row-major: 1 idle aiming, small glowing blue crystal; 2 firing an intense compact electric blue-white discharge; 3 recoil and bright charge; 4 cooling blue arcs between prongs; 5 idle with faint crystal pulse; 6 recovered ready aim. Each is a full independent weapon frame. No environmental background, no fake checkerboard.
prompts.textures: Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: an opaque seamless texture atlas for SIGIL BREACH, a dark 16-bit occult FPS. Square 1024x1024 image split into EXACT four 512x512 quadrants touching without borders or gutters. Flat orthographic diffuse albedo textures only, no perspective, no directional spotlight, no vignette, no labels, no letters, no frames. Deliberate pixel art as if each quadrant were originally 128x128 pixels enlarged 4x with nearest-neighbor, rich handcrafted 1990s shooter textures, clustered dithering, crisp block pixels, avoid photorealism and avoid blurry noise. TOP LEFT: warm ash-gray ancient cathedral masonry, large chipped stone blocks in horizontal courses, soot and sparse dried crimson stains, varied stone shapes, strong readable cracks. TOP RIGHT: dark rusted blackened iron wall panels with bronze rivets and inset ominous bone/skull relief motifs, symmetrical occult gothic metalwork, no recognizable real sigil. BOTTOM LEFT: weathered dark golden bronze trim with horizontal ornate bands, small skull-carvings, chain or thorn relief, scratches. BOTTOM RIGHT: heavy square brown-gray stone floor flagstones, cracked corners, granular worn surfaces, sparse rusty-red seams. Each quadrant must tile convincingly edge-to-edge independently. Mid-value surfaces with deep crevices and light chipped edges so dynamic lighting can be applied by the game. Grimy infernal cathedral mood; no modern text or UI.
